Version: 7.4.0255.22319 I Agree to The Terms of the License, Download Now
Last Modified: 5/6/2026 4:53:37 PM Release Notes
Note: Firmware version 7.4 is NOT compatible with Crestron Home. Please use version 7.3 for Crestron Home.

Change Log:

Note: Firmware version 7.4 is NOT compatible with Crestron Home. Please use version 7.3 for Crestron Home.

New Features
  • DM H.264 encoding:
    • H.264, also known as Advanced Video Coding (AVC) or MPEG-4 Part 10, is the most common video compression standard in use today. It allows for high-quality video encoding at lower bit rates than other compression standards.
  • eARC support:
    • eARC (Enhanced Audio Return Channel) is now supported on DM-NVX-38X and allows transportation of eARC audio between DM-NVX-38X or DM-NAX-XSP devices. It supports the latest high-bitrate multi-channel audio formats like Dolby Atmos, DTS:X and DTS-HD. 
  • Multiview improvements:
    • HDR10 sources are now supported in Multiview windows as long as all windows use the same HDR10 standard. HDR10+ and Dolby Vision are not supported in Multiview with multiple windows. Only full screen mode supports all HDR formats. Mixing of HDR formats is not supported and will result in gray-scaled content for HDR10+/Dolby Vision.
  • Minor bug fixes and security updates.


Associated Models:
  • DM-NVX-384
  • DM-NVX-384C
  • DM-NVX-385
  • DM-NVX-385C
